notes.title: July Update + Randomise maps added
notes.notes:
Hey!  We have fixed a bunch of bugs this month and added some new features.
[list]
[*] Fixed slow-mo bug
[*] Fixed character hat bug
[*] Added text to portal to make starting game clearer
[*] Added random map option 
[*] Updated Dash Animation Effect so that it is different from slam to remove confusion about whether or not you can kill with dash.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 14/10/21
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!
We have been working on some big changes to Smash Crates for the past week but before we get those I wanted to quickly run through what has already been implemented. 
[h1]Completed:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Player controllers (movement etc)
[*] Full controller support (xbox, playstation) 
[*] Procedural environments 
[*] Game State systems 
[*] Player UI
[*] 4 map backgrounds 
[*] Main Menu systems 
[/list]
As the game currently stands it is completely playable and I have been able to get some great feedback from play testers. 
[h1]Recent Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Mega Crate power up where you increase in size and become a huge destructive machine. 
[*] Added Rocket booster power up, gain the ability of flight and fry your opponents with your rockets flames. 
[*] Built Audio manager to keep track of and control all the games audio components. 
[*] Updated procedural build system to include power up crates, embedded into the environment. 
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40916044/711b55d782c51b1af3b68863bd019c2abbe0d26d.png[/img]

Exciting Stuff! 

See you all next time! 
Fat Alien Cat
